note: How the chatgpt-bridge builds and proves this repo. Plain `vp i` dies with ERR_PNPM_EPERM unpacking Expo's prebuilt native binaries while Defender holds them open, so the mobile workspace is excluded — see omni/PLAN.md S1. The task name has to be reached through --filter rather than -r, because the root package has a `typecheck` script of its own and running that one recurses back into mobile. Tests are deliberately not here yet: the suite assumes a POSIX filesystem in several packages and fails on Windows on the trunk, so it would refuse every merge rather than prove anything.
